data.name: Wingsuit: Romsdalen
data.detailed_description:
Experience the ultimate extreme sports adventure set in the heart of Norway’s breathtaking Romsdalen Valley. Soar through the skies, carve up the mountains, explore the stunningly landscapes that this unique region has to offer and make Romsdalen your playground.

In Wingsuit: Romsdalen, you’ll pilots a high-performance wingsuit, navigating the crisp mountain air as you complete challenges, explore the landscapes, fly formations or challenge friends in multiplayer mode. Whether you’re speeding down snow-covered slopes or soaring through the clouds in your wingsuit, every moment is packed with adrenaline-fueled action. On top of all this, the world is packed with challenging gaps and collectibles, so there is always something fresh to explore around the corner.

The game captures the raw beauty of Romsdalen, with its dramatic fjords, towering peaks, and dense forests. Feel the rush of wind in your face as you take on these daring stunts and hidden paths that most haven’t dared to tread. With realistic physics and breathtaking graphics, Wingsuit: Romsdalen brings the spirit of adventure to life like never before.

Each exit point in Wingsuit: Romsdalen is a unique test of skill and courage, designed to push your limits with every flight. From the towering peaks to the narrow valleys, each exit point presents its own set of challenges. Navigate jagged rock formations, dodge dizzying drafts, and brave heart-pounding descents over perilous cliffs.

Join the thrill of Romsdalen’s extreme sports culture and become a champion of the mountains. Are you ready to take flight?

Features

  • Single-player mode with lots of exciting challenges.

  • Online Multiplayer with free roam, races, precision runs or battle mode.

  • Eight wingsuits, each with its unique flying characteristics.

  • Eleven exit points, with a balloon, helicopter and an aircraft at your service, in addition to classic base jumping exits.

  • More than 250 square kilometers of open world, created from a high fidelity digital model of Romsdalen, Norway

  • Formation Run challenges, where you get to test your skills alongside wingsuit pros.

  • Survival Mode, where you face daunting odds without a parachute.

  • Tricky gaps.

  • Global leaderboards.

  • Instant Replays.

  • VR support.

  • Steam Workshop support, create and share your own lines.

data.short_description: Feel the rush of Norway’s Romsdalen Valley in this intense action sports game. Pilot a high-performance wingsuit through challenging exits, daring stunts and vast mountain landscapes. Are you ready to hit the slopes?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 2G or AMD Radeon RX 5500 or Intel Arc A380. (For VR: NVIDIA GTX 1080 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR supported, tracked controllers and gamepad
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
